title: Momax
summary: Momax is a member of the Huntik Foundation Council who is quite plump in size. He is often seen to sit between Metz and Nasher.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Momax was present at the holographic meeting called by Metz to congratulate the Council members on their accomplishments. [Coming of Age]

Momax was present during the meeting where Nasher alerted the council that his Seekers in Tower of Nostradamus had been attacked by the Organization. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

Momax was later present when Focauld Casterwill alerted Teien Casterwill that the Blood Spiral had found him, a matter Teien brought before the council. [The Casterwill Connection] Momax was also present when Dante's team came before the council to discuss the Blood Spiral and were tasked with the mission Call of the Casterwill. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

Momax joined the council on the longest night of the year to discuss plans to stop the activation of the Spiral Mark. [Words from Eathon] During the final battle at the Spiral Mark, he helped Montehue defeat Wind and Shakrit, by utilizing the Mjolnir Hammer. [Dante's Return]

Following the defeat of The Betrayer, Momax was seen with the council as they were joined by a new member, Dante Vale. [Dante's Return]

full_text:
Momax is a member of the Huntik Foundation Council who is quite plump in size. He is often seen to sit between Metz and Nasher.

History

Momax was present at the holographic meeting called by Metz to congratulate the Council members on their accomplishments. [Coming of Age]

Momax was present during the meeting where Nasher alerted the council that his Seekers in Tower of Nostradamus had been attacked by the Organization. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

Momax was later present when Focauld Casterwill alerted Teien Casterwill that the Blood Spiral had found him, a matter Teien brought before the council. [The Casterwill Connection] Momax was also present when Dante's team came before the council to discuss the Blood Spiral and were tasked with the mission Call of the Casterwill. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

Momax joined the council on the longest night of the year to discuss plans to stop the activation of the Spiral Mark. [Words from Eathon] During the final battle at the Spiral Mark, he helped Montehue defeat Wind and Shakrit, by utilizing the Mjolnir Hammer. [Dante's Return]

Following the defeat of The Betrayer, Momax was seen with the council as they were joined by a new member, Dante Vale. [Dante's Return]

Personality

During one of the meeting, he was afraid that his Seekers would be in danger and demanded more security for them. He is quite smart and is always coming up with new ideas to stop the Organization.

Abilities

Momax is quite strong since he is able to wield the extremely heavy Hammer of Thor and defeat Shakrit with the impact.

Gallery

Image caption: Montehue and Momax wield Mjolnir, Thor's Hammer

Trivia

• Momax's name is based off the Museum of Modern Art (or "MoMA") located in New York. This is in keeping the Huntik Foundation Council members all being named after various museums.

Momax was present during the meeting where [[Nasher]] alerted the council that his [[Seekers]] in [[Tower of Nostradamus]] had been attacked by [[the Organization]]. {{Source|The Tower of Nostradamus}}

Momax was later present when [[Focauld Casterwill]] alerted [[Teien Casterwill]] that the [[Blood Spiral]] had found him, a matter Teien brought before the council. {{source|The Casterwill Connection}} Momax was also present when [[Dante]]'s team came before the council to discuss the Blood Spiral and were tasked with the mission [[Call of the Casterwill]]. {{source|The Titan in the Temple of Sun}}

During one of the meeting, he was afraid that his Seekers would be in danger and demanded more security for them. He is quite smart and is always coming up with new ideas to stop [[the Organization]].
